---
title: "Before the day"
---

Before the workshop, install R, an IDE and the IDE workspace, work through the first module on R, and read the background to the case study.

## 1. R and an IDE

[Install R and an IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Install R, Quarto and an IDE by following the guidance on the setup page. The [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) lists common installation errors and gives advice on how to troubleshoot them.

## 2. The IDE workspace {#the-workspace}

[Download the IDE workspace (zip)]({{< var cases.housing.workspace-zip >}}){.btn .btn-primary}

Save the zip file to your hard drive and unzip it, choosing "Extract All" (on Windows) rather than working inside the compressed preview. Open the extracted folder, `ar4ds-housing-workspace-main`, in your IDE: **File → Open Folder** in Positron and VS Code; or by opening the `ar4ds-housing-workspace.Rproj` file in RStudio. Then run `R/check_setup.R`, as the [setup page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html#check-that-it-works) describes, until every line prints OK. The workshop tasks are in the `index.qmd` Quarto file in the same folder.

## 3. Getting started with R

[Open Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work through the module. Its code runs in the browser, so it needs no R installation.

## 4. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read about the case study](../../background.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The case that you will be working on in the workshop examines one claim from a field experiment on how officials at public housing authorities in the United States answered emails from people wanting to apply for housing (Einstein and Glick 2017). The case study background page presents the claim of the original study, and outlines how the five analysts of the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026) have re-analysed it.

## 5. Further preparation

Optional: the modules on [the IDE (Positron and other IDEs)](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html), on [Quarto documents](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html) and on [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html), and the readings on [preregistration](../../resources.qmd#preregistration).

## 6. On the day

Bring your laptop, with the required software and the IDE workspace installed. Don't forget the charger!
